channel.description: Latest Microsoft 365 Message Center messages and Microsoft 365 Roadmap posts from message.cengizyilmaz.net. Message Center posts vary by tenant; always use your tenant's Message Center as the source of truth.

item.title: MC1461152: Create interactive slides in PowerPoint with Copilot skill (Windows and Mac)
item.description: PowerPoint's new "Create interactive slides" feature (Windows and Mac) enables users to easily create full-slide visuals for complex concepts, timelines, comparisons, systems, and data. Available now on Windows and rolling out on Mac by September 2026, it requires no pre-rollout action but recommends admin review and training updates.

item.title: MC1307512: Microsoft Teams: AI-powered notes for in-person meetings with Facilitator in Teams Rooms on Windows
item.description: Microsoft Teams is adding AI-powered meeting notes with the Facilitator agent to Teams Rooms on Windows for in-person meetings. Rolling out worldwide from late October to mid-November 2026, it enables real-time note-taking stored securely in tenant-owned SharePoint. Licensing and configuration prerequisites apply; no extra admin enablement needed.

item.title: MC1307888: Microsoft Teams: AI-powered notes for in-person meetings with Facilitator in Teams Rooms on Android
item.description: Microsoft Teams is expanding AI-powered meeting notes with the Facilitator agent to Teams Rooms on Android, enabling real-time notes during in-person meetings. Notes are securely stored in tenant-owned SharePoint, accessible via meeting recap in Teams desktop. Rollout begins late October 2026, requiring Teams Rooms Pro licensing and specific tenant settings.

item.title: MC1234571: Microsoft Purview | Data Loss Prevention – Adaptive scopes for DLP for SharePoint
item.description: Microsoft Purview introduces adaptive scopes for SharePoint DLP policies, enabling automatic targeting of sites based on attributes, reducing manual updates. Public preview runs February 2026; general availability begins January 2027. Admins must create scopes and assign them to DLP policies to improve efficiency and coverage without impacting user workflows.

item.description: We are announcing the ability to use real-time web tracking and personalization for known and unknown users in Dynamics 365 Customer Insights – Data. This feature will reach general availability on September 30, 2026. How does this affect me? This feature enables two key capabilities: website personalization for known and unknown users, as well as conversion of unknown users to known users. Track unknown user activity. When users return to your site, personalize it based on their previous browsi...

item.title: MC1462654: Dynamics 365 Project Operations- Enable multiple eliminations for an investment project
item.description: We are announcing the ability to enable multiple eliminations for an investment project in Dynamics 365 Project Operations. This feature will reach public preview on September 11, 2026. How does this affect me? This feature removes the restriction on only a single elimination transaction being permitted per investment project. With this change, finance and project accountants can post multiple elimination transactions against a single investment project—supporting staged capitalization, cost ove...

item.description: We are announcing the ability to unify product receipt and item requirement posting in Dynamics 365 Project Operations. This feature will reach public preview on September 11, 2026. How does this affect me? This feature posts a purchase order product receipt and the consumption of its linked project item requirement in one transaction. It applies when automatic item consumption is enabled or when you select "Consume immediately" while posting the product receipt. Both updates succeed together, o...

item.description: We are announcing the ability to post costs for manual transfer from the balance sheet in Dynamics 365 Project Operations. This feature will reach public preview on September 11, 2026. How does this affect me? Organizations may have long running work for internal initiatives or customer facing projects. When cost and revenue profile rules are configured to post costs to the balance sheet (for example, as work in progress assets), there's a point when those costs must be recognized as expenses. A...

item.title: MC1454378: Microsoft 365: The Next Generation of File & Folder Sharing
item.description: Microsoft 365 introduces a third-generation sharing experience with a single "hero link" for files and folders, simplifying access control and updates. Rolling out worldwide from mid-September to late October 2026, it affects SharePoint, OneDrive, and Microsoft 365 sharing, with no required user action before rollout.

item.title: RM415168: Outlook: Automatically display auto-mapped calendars
item.description: Users will be able to automatically see their auto-mapped calendars when toggling from classic Outlook to the new. #newoutlookforwindows

item.title: RM488097: Microsoft Defender for Office 365: Full Submissions experience in GCC
item.description: This is item is no longer accurate and we are removing it from the roadmap, we apologize for any inconvenience.

item.title: RM492622: Microsoft 365: The Next Generation of File & Folder Sharing
item.description: We're now introducing the third generation of the Microsoft 365 sharing experience designed to make collaboration simpler, smarter, and more secure by default. At the heart of this update is the new hero link, a single, powerful link that controls access to your files. Whether you copy a link, share via email, or send the URL from your browser, you now have a seamless and consistent way to share and stay in control of your files.

item.title: RM498923: Viva Glint - Action Taking Report (Public Preview)
item.description: Introduction of a new report that provides transparency into platform activity by dashboard users. Metrics such as report views, Team Conversations completed, and Focus Areas created will be visible and filterable with this report.

item.title: RM523209: Microsoft Purview: Compliance Manager - AI Powered Regulatory Templates
item.description: This feature in Purview Compliance Manager shall enable customers to convert complex regulations from PDF documents to actionable controls and actions in multi cloud environment. Customers can use the converted regulatory templates to create assessments and identify compliance gaps, understand and implement controls to improve their compliance posture.

item.title: RM536576: Microsoft Purview: Compliance Manager-Purview Compliance Manager integration with Microsoft Foundry for automated mapping of AI regulations and evaluation of Compliance controls for Foundry Agents
item.description: This feature in Purview Compliance Manager shall enable customers to automatically access the compliance posture of Agents created in AI Foundry. Customers can map Agents being created in AI Foundry to compliance regulations and assessments in Purview Compliance Manager and get to know the compliance status and improvement actions to be innovative and compliant.

item.title: RM551199: Outlook: Print calendar events in new Outlook and Teams
item.description: Users will now have basic options for printing calendar events in #newoutlookforwindows and Teams calendar, including choosing whether to show all attendees or display a shortened list of up to 10 attendees via a checkbox.

item.title: RM557681: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Intelligent Summaries in Copilot Dashboard
item.description: Use intelligent summaries in Copilot Dashboard to quickly surface what’s working and where targeted attention can accelerate Copilot adoption. Intelligent summaries highlight key adoption trends to focus on areas of success. Suggested prompts enable deeper exploration of underlying trends and drivers.

item.title: RM557970: Microsoft Teams: Centralized notification settings for channels
item.description: Centralized notification settings streamline channel notification setup and management. Available in Teams settings, users have a single place to review and adjust notifications for all visible channels, instead of managing each individually.

item.title: RM558341: Microsoft Teams: Facilitator detects and answers questions
item.description: Facilitator now automatically detects open questions raised during a Teams meeting and offers to help answer them using web search. When a participant asks a question (e.g., “What is an LLM?”) and no one answers, Facilitator posts a prompt offering to find an answer. Participants can select “Yes” to have the agent retrieve and share the information.

item.title: RM562018: SharePoint: AI overview for SharePoint News posts in the SharePoint app for Teams
item.description: Users will be able access an AI generated audio summary of SharePoint News posts in the SharePoint app for Teams (Viva Connections).

item.title: RM565132: Microsoft Teams: Granular channel notification controls
item.description: Microsoft Teams introduces flexible presets for channel notifications, allowing you to choose between All new messages, @mentions and replies, or Mute. You can further customize alerts for unfollowed threads, tags, and channel or team mentions, as well as control banner notifications for the channel. This added flexibility enables you to set notifications to match to your work style and reduce unnecessary distractions.

item.title: RM565863: OneNote: Copilot Notebook in OneNote on Mac
item.description: Copilot Notebook, an AI-powered workspace for a project or topic built on reference materials, is coming to OneNote on Mac. Bring together your work context behind a project in one place.

item.title: RM568786: Microsoft Edge: Inline Switching for Workspaces
item.description: Workspaces Inline Switching manages multiple Workspaces in a single window. Selecting a Workspace swaps in its tabs, theme, and context, with an easy return to the default space.

item.title: RM569206: Microsoft Teams: Pop out calls into a new browser window
item.description: Microsoft Teams browser app users will be able to pop out calls into a simplified call window that stays available while they navigate away from, hide, or minimize the tab or progressive web app (PWA) hosting the call. This helps users multitask and collaborate more easily during calls.

item.title: RM569423: Microsoft Teams: Hide Organizer Name in Calendar View on Teams Panels and MTR-A.
item.description: Admins can now choose whether the organizer name will show up in the calendar view on Teams panels and MTR-Android. In Pro Management Portal, admins can toggle the "Show Organizer Name" setting ON or OFF. On the panel device, admins can toggle the "Show organizer names" setting ON or OFF. On the MTRA console device and All In One Display device, admins can toggle the "Show organizer names on calendar" setting ON or OFF. Based on the selection, the organizer name will or will not be shown on the...

item.title: RM569610: Planner: Track task progress with the Completion (%) field
item.description: The new Completion (%) column in Microsoft Planner provides a more precise view of task progress. Users can view and update completion as a percentage, helping teams communicate incremental progress and quickly understand how far work has advanced.

item.title: RM569930: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Conversational configuration of connectors in Copilot Studio
item.description: Configure the connectors your agent needs, with a simple in-chat sign-in instead of a full settings experience.

item.title: RM569934: Microsoft Teams: Events in Meet app in Teams in GCC
item.description: Users can now use the Teams Meet app to discover events across their organization, track what important events are upcoming, and plan and organize their own professional events. With this release, Meet app will be renamed to Events app.

item.title: MC1462473: Microsoft Teams: PowerPoint Live introduces light mode for presenters
item.description: PowerPoint Live in Microsoft Teams will add a light mode option alongside dark, classic, and high contrast modes for presenters starting September 2026. This update enhances flexibility, accessibility, and personalization without affecting presentation content or attendee views. No admin action is needed.

item.title: MC1462472: Microsoft 365 Copilot: Draft Outlook emails directly in Copilot Chat on mobile
item.description: Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat on mobile will embed an Outlook email draft experience, allowing users to draft, review, and open emails in Outlook Mobile seamlessly. This feature, enabled by default, rolls out worldwide from mid-August to mid-September 2026 with no admin action required.

item.title: MC1462471: Microsoft SharePoint : Dashboard Card Visibility on Mobile
item.description: Dashboard authors can now control the visibility of individual SharePoint dashboard cards on mobile devices, enhancing mobile user experience. This feature will roll out globally from late August to early September 2026. No action is required, but authors are encouraged to optimize dashboards for mobile users.

item.title: MC1462470: Microsoft Teams: Clearer text highlighting in dark mode and high contrast mode
item.description: Microsoft Teams will improve highlighted text visibility in dark and high contrast modes for a more consistent, accessible editing experience. Rollout starts mid-September 2026, completing by early October 2026. This is a visual enhancement only; no user action is required.

item.title: MC1462469: Microsoft Teams and Google Calendar sync retirement
item.description: Microsoft is retiring calendar syncing between Microsoft Teams and Google Workspace in October 2026, ending support for this feature. Organizations should notify users, save account matching data, and use the Microsoft Teams Meeting add-on for Google Workspace for meeting scheduling instead.

item.title: MC1462467: Badges on profile cards in Teams
item.description: Microsoft Teams profile cards will display Awards and Certifications from Microsoft 365 profiles starting mid-September 2026. This read-only feature appears if these properties are populated, showing titles and issuers with details on selection. It also applies to Outlook and Microsoft 365 Copilot app. No action needed if already used.

item.title: MC1462464: Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps: App Governance support for the Cloud Application Administrator role is being retired
item.description: Support for the Cloud Application Administrator role in Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps' App Governance will retire on September 26, 2026. Organizations must reassign affected administrators to supported roles like Security Administrator to maintain access when URBAC is enabled. Review role assignments by September 25, 2026.

item.title: MC1462463: Teams Admin Center - Single pane for monitoring
item.description: Microsoft Teams admin center will launch a single pane for monitoring and troubleshooting meetings and calls organization-wide, available from late September to mid-October 2026. Admins can view in-progress and completed meetings, identify issues, use detailed diagnostics, apply filters, export data, and leverage Microsoft 365 Copilot for analysis.

item.title: MC1462460: Microsoft Entra: Domain update for My Account and identity self-service experiences
item.description: Microsoft Entra is updating its self-service identity management domain from myaccount.microsoft.com to myaccount.cloud.microsoft, consolidating related sites for a unified experience. The change rolls out worldwide in late November 2026. Users need no action; administrators should ensure *.cloud.microsoft domains are allowed in network policies.

item.title: MC1309743: Viva Engage: Email updates for frontline users without an active Exchange mailbox
item.description: Starting mid-September 2026, Viva Engage will stop sending email notifications to users without valid mailboxes, reducing email system load and improving delivery. Users with supported mailboxes will be unaffected. Notifications via Teams remain unchanged. No action is required, but admins should review mailbox configurations and update support documentation.

item.title: MC1454386: Simplified access to Copilot Chat on the Microsoft 365 Copilot mobile app
item.description: Access to Copilot Chat on the Microsoft 365 Copilot mobile app will be simplified by removing restrictions from the Intune policy and "Analyze content" privacy control. This change, rolling out August to September 2026, requires no admin action but may affect organizational controls and documentation.

How this will affect your organization: If your Microsoft 365 Apps clients are configured to automatically update from the Office Content Delivery Network (CDN), then no action is required. If you manage updates directly you can now download this late...

item.title: MC1192260: Microsoft Purview | Compliance Manager - AI Powered Regulatory Templates
item.description: Microsoft Purview Compliance Manager will introduce AI Powered Regulatory Templates to convert regulatory PDFs into actionable controls, aiding compliance in multi-cloud environments. Public preview starts November 2025; general availability begins October 2026. The feature is additive, requires no action to enable, and supports streamlined assessments without impacting existing workflows.

item.title: MC1266912: Microsoft 365 Copilot: Intelligent Summaries in Copilot Dashboard
item.description: Microsoft 365 Copilot Dashboard will add AI-generated intelligent summaries by late September 2026, highlighting adoption trends and usage insights for admins. The feature is on by default, requires no configuration, and includes suggested prompts. No user impact or compliance issues are expected.

item.title: MC1388719: Microsoft Teams: Granular channel notification settings
item.description: Microsoft Teams will introduce granular channel notification presets—All new messages, Mentions and replies, and Mute—with customizable options for mentions and threads. Rollout begins October 2026 across platforms and environments, enabled by default with no admin changes needed. No user action required; inform helpdesk and update documentation.

item.title: MC1409304: Microsoft Teams: Facilitator proactively detects and resolves knowledge gaps in meetings
item.description: Microsoft Teams will introduce a Facilitator feature with Microsoft 365 Copilot (Premium) that detects knowledge gaps in meetings, performs web searches, and posts relevant answers in the chat to improve productivity. It requires manual enabling, supports standard meetings, and includes admin controls for configuration.

item.title: MC1461157: Microsoft Teams: Proximity join support for attendees in Teams events from Teams Rooms on Windows and Android
item.description: Microsoft Teams Rooms on Windows and Android will support attendee proximity join for Teams events, enabling faster connection to nearby room systems. Rollout starts October 2026, completing by mid-November. The feature activates automatically, requiring no action, and improves joining town halls, webinars, and meetings.

item.title: MC1459141: Microsoft Teams: Admin policy to automatically block identified external meeting bots from joining meetings
item.description: Microsoft Teams will introduce a new admin policy to automatically block identified external meeting bots from joining meetings, enhancing security. The rollout starts mid-September 2026, with default off. Admins can enable and assign this policy; no changes occur unless activated. Recommendations include piloting and communication.

item.title: MC1319216: Microsoft Teams: In‑meeting toggle to turn Meeting AI on or off
item.description: Microsoft Teams will add a toggle for licensed organizers and presenters to turn Meeting AI (Copilot and Facilitator) on or off during meetings, starting mid-September 2026. Turning off AI disables recording and transcription. The feature respects existing policies, requires no action, and aims to enhance control over AI use in meetings.

item.title: MC1462013: Dynamics 365 Project Operations - Enable the Investment project feature
item.description: We are announcing the ability to enable the Investment project feature in Dynamics 365 Project Operations. This feature will reach general availability on September 25, 2026. How does this affect me? This feature enables organizations to manage internal capital initiatives, such as infrastructure development, research and development, and asset creation. It enhances financial governance, streamlines asset capitalization, and aligns project execution with strategic goals. Key functionality of thi...

item.title: RM491016: Microsoft Purview Compliance Portal: DLP Policy Tip Support in Outlook Mobile
item.description: DLP policy tip support for Outlook Mobile enhances data loss prevention measures on mobile devices by providing real-time alerts to help users avoid accidentally sharing sensitive information, ensuring compliance with organizational policies.

item.title: RM498491: Microsoft Purview compliance portal: Tip Support in Outlook for Mac
item.description: DLP policy tips for Microsoft Outlook for Mac provide real-time notifications to users when their email contains sensitive information that violates organizational policies. Users can see policy tips directly in the mail tip UI and have the option to remove non-compliant recipients or override the policy if necessary. This feature ensures compliance by alerting users to potential data loss risks before sending emails.

item.title: RM550514: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Newly created Declarative Agents now understand referenced scanned PDFs
item.description: Any newly created Declarative Agents can now reliably ground answers in scanned PDFs and image-based documents referenced from SharePoint, unlocking a major class of enterprise content that was previously hard to use in agent scenarios.

item.title: RM560535: Outlook: 1-year and 2-year options for email sync window (Offline settings)
item.description: In the new Outlook for Windows, users can choose to save 1 year or 2 years of email on their device for offline access. This expands the existing offline settings and allows users to access more email when they are not connected to the internet. The new options are available under Settings > General > Offline > Days of email to save, giving users greater flexibility based on their storage and offline needs."

item.title: RM560702: Microsoft Teams: Security Detection Report in Teams Admin Center
item.description: A new Security Detection Report in the Teams admin center provides a centralized view of messaging security detections, including impersonation, malicious URLs, and weaponizable file types. Admins can review detection activity in one place and export detailed data to support investigation and response. This capability helps consolidate security signals for Teams messaging scenarios.

item.title: RM561208: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management – Archive SharePoint files under retention
item.description: We are introducing file archiving support in SharePoint Online, utilizing this feature administrators can seamlessly include archiving actions within their existing data retention policies. This means that, in addition to keeping or deleting data, admins can now leverage Purview DLM to archive files according to organizational requirements, ensuring comprehensive governance across all stages of the content lifecycle in SharePoint Online. Retention based file archiving moves inactive content to l...

item.title: RM562994: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention - Reduce policy sync status SLA on the Purview UI from 2 hours to 30 mins
item.description: Policy updates in Microsoft Purview now sync faster, reducing wait times from up to 2 hours to just 30 minutes, so your protections stay up to date and take effect more quickly across your organization.

item.title: RM565220: Microsoft Teams: Open message links in new window
item.description: Teams now enables links within chat and channel messages to open in a new window, so you can compare information side by side without losing the context of your ongoing conversation. Access this capability through the More options menu or by using Ctrl/Cmd + click.

item.title: RM568367: Outlook: Drag and Drop
item.description: You can now reschedule events by dragging them to a new time slot in your calendar. This feature is available in day and multi day views.

item.title: RM568781: Microsoft Teams: Proximity join support for attendees in Teams events from Teams Rooms on Windows and Android
item.description: Attendees can take advantage of proximity join with Teams Rooms on Windows and/or Android for fast, effortless connection to nearby room systems during Teams events, such as town halls, webinars, and structured meetings.

item.title: RM569205: Microsoft Teams: Temporarily pause all notifications
item.description: Users can now temporarily pause all notifications to minimize interruptions and stay focused on important work, meetings, or other priorities, without changing their existing notification settings.

item.title: RM569928: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Power BI reports as references in Copilot Notebooks
item.description: Copilot Notebooks now lets users add Power BI reports as references, bringing report data directly into their notebooks alongside files. Copilot uses this information to help generate more relevant summaries, presentations, and briefs grounded in the organization's data.

item.title: RM569929: Planner: Connected Plans
item.description: Connected Plans let teams link related plans together to organize work across projects and initiatives. Navigate between connected plans and make related work easier to find and manage.

item.title: MC1461705: Microsoft Defender XDR: Unified identity timeline on the Identity page
item.description: Microsoft Defender XDR is enhancing the Identity page's Timeline tab to provide a unified, chronological view of identity-related activities and alerts from multiple Microsoft security sources. Rolling out mid-September to mid-October 2026, it offers improved context, filtering, and automatic updates without changing existing policies. No action is required to enable it.

item.title: MC1461704: Microsoft Defender XDR: Unified response actions across identity accounts
item.description: Microsoft Defender XDR unifies identity response actions across linked accounts, enabling security teams to manage actions like disabling accounts or forcing password changes from one workflow. It supports multiple identity systems and SaaS apps, enhancing response speed and consistency. Rollout begins mid-October 2026 worldwide.

item.title: MC1446796: Migrate Free/Busy, MailTips, and Calendar Sharing before EWS deprecation
item.description: Exchange Web Services (EWS) deprecation starts October 1, 2026, affecting cross-tenant Free/Busy, MailTips, and Calendar Sharing. Migration to Microsoft 365 Cross-Tenant Access Policy begins September 2026, with rollout completing by October 2026. Organizations must migrate to avoid service disruption. Hybrid/on-premises scenarios are excluded.

item.title: MC1446799: Microsoft Teams: Multilingual meeting recaps support personalized recap translation
item.description: Microsoft Teams will personalize meeting recaps by displaying them initially in each participant's selected translation or interpretation language, with options to change languages afterward. This enhances multilingual collaboration and accessibility, rolling out globally from early August to early September 2026, requiring no admin action.

item.title: MC1443517: Microsoft Teams: External presenters can manage event production controls
item.description: Microsoft Teams will allow trusted external presenters (federated B2B and guest users) to manage event production controls starting early August 2026. Organizers can assign these permissions via the "Who has control of production tools" setting, enabling external partners to manage attendee experiences during Teams events.

item.title: MC1325441: Microsoft Purview | Data Lifecycle Management - Archive OneDrive and SharePoint files under retention
item.description: Microsoft Purview Data Lifecycle Management will add an Archive option to retention policies, allowing admins to move inactive SharePoint and OneDrive files to Microsoft 365 Archive. Archived content remains compliant and discoverable but is excluded from Copilot indexing. Rollout begins September 2026 and requires admin configuration.

item.title: MC1441775: Microsoft Whiteboard: Retirement of legacy whiteboards and transition to OneDrive-backed whiteboards
item.description: Microsoft Whiteboard is retiring legacy whiteboards and the standalone app. Migration to OneDrive-backed whiteboards must be completed by September 25, 2026. Legacy whiteboards will be deleted October 16, 2026, and the standalone app deprecated November 30, 2026. Users must migrate or export content before these dates.

item.title: MC1461529: Release Planner Retirement: D365, Power Platform, and Dataverse Move to AI at Work
item.description: Starting this fall, Dynamics 365, Power Platform, and Dataverse roadmap content is joining the AI at Work roadmap , giving customers a single destination to discover upcoming capabilities, track rollout progress, and plan adoption across Microsoft's business applications, productivity, and AI portfolio. As part of this transition, Release Planner will retire on November 15, 2026. Microsoft is also retiring the twice-yearly release wave communication model in favor of continuous roadmap disclosur...

item.title: MC1461528: Microsoft 365 Roadmap is becoming the AI at Work Roadmap
item.description: On August 25, 2026, Microsoft 365 Roadmap will be renamed AI at Work Roadmap, expanding to include Dynamics 365, Power Platform, and Dataverse updates from September 2026. It centralizes AI-powered innovation tracking without changing access or workflows; no immediate action is required.

item.title: MC1461165: Microsoft Teams: Facilitator can join channel meetings
item.description: Microsoft Teams will allow adding Facilitator to channel meetings to take notes, manage agendas, answer questions, and handle tasks. Rollout starts mid-September 2026, completing by mid-October 2026. No action or compliance changes are required for organizations with Facilitator enabled.

item.title: MC1461164: Microsoft Teams Rooms on Android: room users can change the app language
item.description: Teams Rooms on Android will allow users to temporarily change the app language per session from the console, aligning with Windows experience. This feature rolls out from June to October 2026 with app version 2.12.0+, resets after restart, requires no admin action, and does not affect system settings.

item.title: RM503564: Microsoft 365 admin center: Organizational Messages now supports Hybrid-joined Devices
item.description: Organizational Messages now supports Hybrid-joined Devices.

item.title: RM512431: Planner: Custom Templates
item.description: Custom templates let you create reusable, pre-designed layouts tailored to your organization’s needs, ensuring consistency and saving time. They provide flexibility to standardize content while allowing easy customization for specific scenarios.

item.title: RM558547: Microsoft Purview: Data Security Investigations – analyze files tied to endpoint DLP alerts
item.description: Speed up analysis of exfiltrated content by launching Data Security Investigations (DSI) from endpoint Data Loss Prevention (DLP) alerts. In DSI, define your endpoint DLP query (for example, time range, users, and endpoints). DSI then automatically gathers the related files that triggered the alerts for review (for example, UserA downloaded a file on 3/1/2026).

item.title: RM558852: Microsoft Teams: Digital signage support for Teams panels
item.description: Digital signage can now be displayed on idle Teams panel devices, similar to digital signage support for Microsoft Teams Rooms front of room displays. Signage source and settings can be configured in the Pro Management portal. Available with Teams Rooms Pro or Shared space-licensed spaces.

item.title: RM558928: Planner: Microsoft Planner tab support for shared and private channels in Microsoft Teams
item.description: Now you can add Microsoft Planner as a tab in shared and private channels in Microsoft Teams, which allows to create and manage tasks directly within the channel.

item.title: RM561031: Microsoft Teams: Enhanced bookable desk experience with Teams panel-based desk dock devices
item.description: Users have better experiences in flexible work environments with Microsoft Teams panel-based desk dock devices coming later this year. The Teams panel app now enables devices, such as the Yealink Linkhub, to enhance bookable desk experiences by indicating at-a-glance availability and letting visitors book directly on the device. Each device requires a Teams Shared Space license.

item.title: RM561922: Universal Print: Universal Print Portal
item.description: You can release your secure print jobs by scanning a QR code at any printer and access your print workflows from a browser on any device, all signed in with your Microsoft 365 account.

item.title: RM565905: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): People Skills- removal and deletion admin control
item.description: A new admin control in the People Skills settings lets administrators permanently remove their organization's People Skills data from the tenant. With this new control, organizations can delete their entire skills library along with all users confirmed, inferred, and imported skills data—giving them full control to offboard from People Skills in support of data governance and compliance needs.

item.title: RM569430: Outlook: Manage Multiple Inbox Rules at Once
item.description: You will soon be able to manage multiple inbox rules at the same time. Select every rule or choose only the ones you want to update. You can then delete, enable, or disable the selected rules in one action. This makes it faster and easier to keep your rules organized. #newoutlookforwindows

item.title: RM569716: Outlook: Purview Data Loss Prevention support for Calendar Events in Outlook mobile apps
item.description: Outlook for iOS and Android will support Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention (DLP) policies for calendar events. Organizations can detect and help prevent the sharing of sensitive information in meeting subjects, descriptions, and invite content through policy tips, user remediation, and policy enforcement. This provides consistent compliance protection across email and calendar experiences on mobile devices.

item.title: RM569718: Outlook: Purview DLP Wait-on-Send Support for Outlook mobile apps
item.description: Outlook for iOS and Android will support Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention (DLP) wait-on-send policies. Organizations can require a DLP evaluation before an email is sent and configure how long users must wait for policy evaluation to complete. This helps ensure sensitive information is inspected against organizational policies before messages leave the organization while providing administrators with flexible control over the user experience.

item.title: RM569719: Outlook: Purview DLP Wait-on-Send Support for Mac
item.description: Outlook for Mac will support Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention (DLP) wait-on-send policies. Organizations can require a DLP evaluation before an email is sent and configure how long users must wait for policy evaluation to complete. This helps ensure sensitive information is inspected against organizational policies before messages leave the organization while providing administrators with flexible control over the user experience.

item.title: MC1458483: OneDrive macOS Native Sync Engine
item.description: Microsoft is introducing a new Native Sync Engine for OneDrive on macOS, improving sync speed, reliability, and resource efficiency. Rollout begins September 2026, completing by November. No admin action is required, but admins should notify users about Finder sidebar changes and update documentation accordingly.

item.title: MC1258000: Microsoft Purview: Data Security Investigations – analyze files tied to endpoint DLP alerts
item.description: Microsoft Purview’s Data Security Investigations will add endpoint Data Loss Prevention (DLP) events as a queryable source, enabling admins to analyze related files automatically. Rollout occurs June to September 2026, enhancing investigation efficiency without user impact or required admin action.

item.title: MC1461160: Microsoft Teams: Copilot in call recap in the Queues app
item.description: Microsoft Teams is adding Copilot in call recap within the Queues app for recorded call queue calls, enabling users with Microsoft 365 Copilot and Teams Premium licenses to get summaries and ask questions about calls. Rollout starts early September 2026 with no admin action required.

item.title: MC1461158: Prepare for upcoming changes to the Excel Exchange connector
item.description: New Exchange Mail and Calendar connectors for Excel Power Query will replace the current Microsoft Exchange connector by April 2027. Workbook owners must manually migrate connections and upgrade to Microsoft 365 Apps or Office 2024. Admins should prepare users and workbooks for this transition starting now.

item.title: MC1461154: Microsoft Purview | Information Protection – Auto-labeling scale increase for SharePoint and OneDrive
item.description: Microsoft Purview auto-labeling for SharePoint and OneDrive increases daily processing from 100,000 to 500,000 files per tenant, enabling faster labeling of large content volumes. Rollout starts September 2026 (preview) and October 2026 (general). No action needed for current users; new users are encouraged to create and validate policies.

item.title: MC1461153: Microsoft Teams: Add multiple steps when building a workflow from scratch
item.description: Microsoft Teams Workflows will soon support multiple sequential actions in a single workflow, enabling richer automations to reduce manual tasks, consolidate processes, and improve productivity. The feature rolls out worldwide in early to mid-September 2026, requiring no admin action but user awareness updates.

item.title: MC1447678: Microsoft Exchange Online: Prepare for Exchange Web Services retirement with EWSAllowedAppIDs
item.description: Exchange Web Services (EWS) in Exchange Online will retire starting October 1, 2026, with full retirement by April 1, 2027. Microsoft introduced EWSAllowedAppIDs, allowing admins to create an allow list of approved apps to use EWS, helping manage access and prevent disruptions during retirement enforcement.

item.title: MC1431365: Copilot Analytics - Agent 365 dashboard for managers
item.description: Managers with team-level access to Microsoft Copilot Analytics in Viva Insights will gain visibility into Agent 365 adoption and usage across their teams via the Agent 365 Dashboard. This rollout begins in late August 2026, allowing managers to monitor agent activity within their access scope and manage feature access through VFAM controls.

item.title: MC1411574: Microsoft Entra: System-preferred authentication now applies to first-factor authentication
item.description: Microsoft Entra now applies system-preferred authentication to first-factor sign-ins for tenants in the Microsoft managed state, selecting the most secure registered method. Rollout is from late June to late September 2026. Tenants can keep or change this setting and should update user guidance accordingly.

item.title: MC1388706: Microsoft 365 Copilot: Legal agent available in Frontier worldwide
item.description: Microsoft 365 Copilot’s Legal agent in Word is now in Public Preview worldwide for Frontier users, expanding from the US. It helps legal professionals review contracts, identify risks, compare clauses, and generate edits using AI. Available mid-June 2026, with general availability in October 2026.

item.title: MC1454108: Microsoft 365 Copilot app update: Simpler Copilot access
item.description: Microsoft 365 Copilot app is updating to a unified app for personal and work accounts with clearer visual cues, a simpler name and icon, and a new web URL (copilot.cloud.microsoft). Rollout begins mid-August 2026, with no changes to security, compliance, or enterprise controls.

item.title: MC1459138: Microsoft Teams: Local Pan-tilt-zoom (PTZ) controls for Microsoft Teams Rooms on Windows
item.description: Microsoft Teams Rooms on Windows will add native local Pan-Tilt-Zoom (PTZ) camera controls for compatible mechanical or optical PTZ cameras, allowing users to adjust cameras directly from the room console during meetings. Rollout starts September 2026, requires no action, and support for digital PTZ will come later.

item.title: MC1459136: Microsoft 365 admin center: Usage reports migrating to new domains
item.description: Microsoft 365 admin center Usage reports domains will change starting mid-August 2026, with current and new domains active in parallel for at least 30 days. Organizations must update firewall, proxy, and scripts to include new domains to avoid access issues. Redirects and domain retirements will be announced later.

item.title: MC1459133: Microsoft Entra ID: Passkey support for B2B users
item.description: Microsoft Entra ID will support passkey registration and sign-in for B2B users to meet resource tenant MFA requirements, enhancing phishing resistance. This feature, enabled by default, rolls out from October 2026 to February 2027, requiring no admin action but recommending policy reviews to align user scopes and MFA settings.

item.title: MC1459132: Microsoft Edge: Retirement of Windows Information Protection (WIP) and Microsoft Defender Application Guard (MDAG)
item.description: Microsoft Edge will retire support for Windows Information Protection (WIP) and Microsoft Defender Application Guard (MDAG) by late September 2026. Organizations using these on Windows 10 must migrate to Microsoft Purview solutions and Edge's built-in security features, as these capabilities are already removed in Windows 11 version 24H2.

item.title: MC1459131: Microsoft Teams: Prepare custom apps for private and shared channel compatibility
item.description: Microsoft Teams will roll out a feature by September 2026 to help admins identify custom line-of-business apps needing updates for private and shared channel compatibility. Updating these apps ensures business continuity, reduces support issues, and maintains app access across evolving channel experiences.

item.title: MC1459130: Improved capabilities for files with Copilot in OneDrive Web
item.description: Copilot in OneDrive Web enables users with a Microsoft 365 Copilot license to find, understand, analyze, create, and act on files using natural language without opening each file. It respects existing permissions and governance, rolling out from August 2026 as an opt-out preview with unified controls for OneDrive and SharePoint.

item.title: MC1459129: Microsoft Viva: Viva Learning retirement of Microsoft 365 training content
item.description: Microsoft is retiring 161 Microsoft 365 training modules and selected articles from Viva Learning on September 21, 2026, removing outdated content. item.description: Teams Rooms on Android now supports coordinated meetings, enabling paired Teams Rooms on Android devices and Android-based touch boards to work together in the same hybrid meeting experience. This feature enables coordinated join and leave, and collaboration across front-of-room displays and touch boards. This creates more immersive and flexible meeting spaces for both in-room and remote participants.

item.description: Capacity view shows a timeline of who's working on what, so you can see how work is distributed across your team and spot overload or open capacity at a glance.

item.title: MC1387578: Microsoft Defender for Office 365: Localized default mark and notify email template
item.description: Microsoft Defender for Office 365 will localize the default "Mark and notify" email template based on users' Outlook language settings, improving clarity in user-reported message notifications. item.title: MC1458484: Filter Messages by Events
item.description: Outlook will add an "Events" filter to help users quickly find calendar invitations and event-related messages. Rolling out globally from late August to September 2026, it requires no admin action but suggests updating user communications and support materials.

item.title: MC1458480: Microsoft Edge: Security Update Alerts in the Edge management service
item.description: Administrators can set severity thresholds to receive alerts for Microsoft Edge updates with significant security fixes, including zero-day patches. item.description: The SharePoint FAQ web part's Content Update flow, which provided AI-generated answer suggestions, will be retired worldwide by late September 2026. Authors must manually edit FAQs going forward. Existing content remains unaffected, no admin action is needed, but authors should be informed and training updated accordingly.

item.title: MC1458477: AI overview for SharePoint News posts in the SharePoint app for Teams
item.description: Users with eligible Microsoft 365 Copilot licenses can access AI-generated audio summaries of SharePoint News posts in the SharePoint app for Teams starting mid-August 2026. item.description: Microsoft is introducing an optional setting in Outlook on the web and new Outlook for Windows to mimic classic Outlook’s look and feel. No admin action is required.

item.title: MC1458474: Microsoft Entra ID: Retirement of custom CSS layout and positioning properties in company branding
item.description: Microsoft Entra ID will retire custom CSS layout and positioning properties in company branding by late October 2026 to enhance security and reduce phishing risks. Organizations using these properties must update branding configurations before then; new use will be blocked from July 21, 2026. Branding will revert to default layouts after retirement.

item.title: MC1458472: Simplified Copilot experience in Microsoft Teams
item.description: Microsoft Teams' Copilot experience will be simplified with a chat-centered design, improved navigation, updated chat layout, Work IQ controls, and a new Tasks view in full-screen mode. The update, available September 2026, requires no user action but administrators should update training and support materials accordingly.

item.title: MC1458470: Simplified Copilot experience in Microsoft Outlook
item.description: Microsoft Outlook's Copilot experience will be refreshed by September 2026 with a simplified, chat-centered design in both full-page and side pane views. Enhancements include improved navigation, chat layout, agent interaction, and Work IQ controls. No user or admin action is needed; administrators should update related documentation and inform users.

item.title: MC1455014: Microsoft Teams: Teams Events Attendance and Engagement Report Policy
item.description: Microsoft Teams now separates attendance and engagement report controls for Teams Events from Teams Meetings via a new CsTeamsEventsPolicy. Rollout begins mid-October 2026. Administrators can independently configure report access with four policy options. Review and update policies and documentation accordingly after rollout.

item.title: RM506743: Microsoft 365: PAYGO consumption-based meter for your extra SharePoint storage needs
item.description: Use the new PAYGO consumption-based meter to pay for your extra SharePoint storage needs. This reduces the operational overhead associated with purchasing extra storage packs and more seamlessly integrates with Microsoft 365 Archive.

item.title: RM553594: Built‑in AI Interpreter for Calls on Teams Phone Devices
item.description: With AI Interpreter, Teams Phone Devices provide real‑time language interpretation directly within the call experience. Users can participate naturally in multilingual conversations while the device interprets spoken audio, reducing language barriers and supporting clearer communication in everyday calling scenarios.

item.title: RM559482: Microsoft Viva: Recent feed in Viva Engage
item.description: Introducing a new “Recent” feed in Home to give users a more predictable view of followed and priority communications, while preserving the existing personalized “For you” experience.

item.title: RM562352: Microsoft 365: Pay-as-you-go storage for OneDrive
item.description: New pay-as-you-go, consumption-based meter for additional OneDrive storage. Control which OneDrive accounts can grow beyond their licensed storage limits and give selected users more space as needed.

item.title: RM562665: Microsoft Teams: Interpreter agent support in Teams Rooms on Android
item.description: The Interpreter agent acts as a translator in Microsoft Teams meetings, allowing participants to listen to the meeting in their chosen language with real-time translation so speaking different languages isn’t a barrier to effective understanding and collaboration. It's now available in Teams Rooms on Android licensed for Teams Rooms Pro.

item.title: RM565870: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention - Data Loss Prevention to safeguard sensitive information from external web search in Microsoft 356 Copilot and Copilot Chat
item.description: We are expanding Microsoft Purview DLP for Microsoft 365 Copilot to safeguard web searches containing sensitive data. This real-time control helps organizations mitigate data leakage and oversharing risks by preventing Microsoft 365 Copilot and Copilot Chat from using sensitive data for external web search.

item.title: RM566700: Microsoft Teams: IntelliFrame people labels in Teams Rooms on Windows
item.description: Remote meeting participants know who is in the room and better follow the conversation with new IntelliFrame people labels that identify in-room participants and provide a hover-over contact card using voice and face profiles on intelligent cameras and in the cloud. Available with Teams Rooms on Windows licensed for Teams Rooms Pro.

item.title: RM567301: Microsoft Teams: New controls for quick views in the chat list
item.description: The new chats and channels experience introduced quick views at the top of the chat and channels list. These are views into mentions, followed threads and more. This update allows users to choose when and how these quick views are shown. Users will have options such as always show, always hide and show only when unread. Users will also be able to collapse the quick views section.

item.title: RM567468: Microsoft Teams: Modernized Gallery view in Teams Rooms on Android
item.description: The updated Gallery view in Teams Rooms on Android prioritizes video on the meeting stage, arranges participants in consistent aspect ratios, and minimizes movement of participant tiles on stage. Users can hide the room self-preview video and choose to see audio and video participants equally on stage, instead of prioritizing video participants. Admins can choose the default behavior using local device settings and the Pro Management portal.

item.title: RM568365: Microsoft Edge: Import Google account data anytime from Settings
item.description: Microsoft Edge now lets users import their Google account data - including passwords, bookmarks, history, and autofill data - directly from Edge Settings, at any time after setup. Previously, users had no way to import this data from a Google account outside the first-run experience. With this update, the import flow is unified into a single, streamlined entry point in Settings that combines import from Google Chrome import and Google account.

item.title: RM568788: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Self-serve sync connectors
item.description: Self-serve sync connectors enable users to securely connect their own external data sources, such as Jira and Confluence Cloud, to Microsoft 365 Copilot. Using their own credentials and permissions, users can synchronize content they already have access to, making it discoverable in Copilot Chat and Microsoft Search. Administrators maintain oversight through tenant-level controls, including staged rollout, visibility management, and connector disablement.

item.title: RM569428: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365) Writing Blocks in M365 Copilot
item.description: M365 Copilot now supports Writing blocks. Edit drafts, memos, emails, and more inline while using Chat for easy editing and iteration.

item.title: RM569435: Microsoft Viva: Viva Glint – In-product access to feature announcements
item.description: Viva Glint service administrators will see a new announcement icon in the product header that links directly to the Viva Glint Tech Community blog. This makes it easier to discover product news, feature announcements, and best practices.

item.title: RM569447: Microsoft Teams: Breakout room support on Teams Rooms on Android
item.description: With breakout room support, Teams Rooms on Android can be added to a breakout room and moved in and out of the main room making it easy for breakout session coordination.

item.title: RM569606: Microsoft Viva: Viva Glint – Enhanced multiple-choice questions with up to 500 options
item.description: Viva Glint administrators will be able to create multiple-choice questions with up to 500 options and upload options using a CSV file. For questions containing more than 50 options, survey takers can search and filter the available responses, making longer lists faster and easier to navigate. Reporting will support the expanded option set.

item.title: RM569609: Microsoft Teams: Report a Message or an External User for Security Concern in Gov Clouds
item.description: Users in Gov clouds can now report suspicious messages and external users within Teams. Reports are surfaced in the Teams admin center, giving admins greater visibility into potentially malicious activity and enabling them to investigate and take appropriate action. By incorporating end-user reports as an additional security signal, this capability helps organizations identify and respond more quickly to phishing, impersonation, spam, and other messaging threats.

item.title: RM569717: Outlook: Purview Data Loss Prevention support for Calendar Events in Outlook for Mac
item.description: Outlook for Mac will support Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention (DLP) policies for calendar events. Organizations can detect and help prevent the sharing of sensitive information in meeting subjects, descriptions, and invite content through policy tips, user remediation, and policy enforcement. This provides consistent compliance protection across email and calendar experiences on Mac devices.

item.title: MC1419798: Microsoft Teams Rooms: Identify in-room participants with IntelliFrame people labels
item.description: Microsoft Teams Rooms on Windows will introduce IntelliFrame people labels by mid-October 2026, automatically identifying enrolled in-room participants with name labels and contact cards for remote attendees. This feature enhances hybrid meetings, requires Teams Rooms Pro licenses, supports voice and face recognition enrollment, and can be managed via Teams meeting policies.

item.title: MC1438571: Default visibility of additional profile card properties in Microsoft 365 profile cards
item.description: Microsoft 365 will change the default visibility of 11 profile card properties to display by default when populated, starting late September 2026. Administrators can review and hide specific properties using Microsoft Graph APIs before rollout. Visibility remains manageable post-rollout via the admin center.

item.title: MC1423118: OneDrive for the web: Document library views now available in OneDrive
item.description: OneDrive for the web now lets users access, switch, create, and manage SharePoint document library views directly within OneDrive, enhancing productivity without changing data or permissions. The feature rolls out worldwide from mid-July to late August 2026 and is enabled by default. No action is required.

item.title: MC1323266: Power BI integration with Microsoft 365 Copilot
item.description: Starting mid-June 2026, Microsoft 365 Copilot will answer questions using Power BI data for Frontier-enrolled organizations, respecting existing permissions. The feature is enabled by default, with admin controls available. Rollout spans Frontier and worldwide through early September 2026, requiring Microsoft 365 Copilot Premium and Power BI licenses.

item.title: MC1454996: Copilot Chat can float over your Outlook iPad and Mac window
item.description: Copilot Chat in Outlook for Mac and iPad can now be popped out into a floating, resizable window for easier multitasking. This feature, enabled by default, will roll out worldwide from late August to mid-September 2026. No action is required, but user notification is recommended.

item.title: RM484854: Microsoft Purview compliance portal: Data Loss Prevention - DLP Policy Tip Support in Outlook for Mac
item.description: DLP policy tips for Microsoft Outlook for Mac provide real-time notifications to users when their email contains sensitive information that violates organizational policies. Users can see policy tips directly in the mail tip UI and have the option to remove non-compliant recipients or override the policy if necessary. This feature ensures compliance by alerting users to potential data loss risks before sending emails.

item.title: RM513278: Planner: Available in Outlook
item.description: Planner in Outlook brings all your tasks, plans, and the new Planner Agent directly into your inbox, so you can manage work where you already work.

item.title: RM533043: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Updated UI for Copilot Chat entry point in Word, Excel and PowerPoint apps
item.description: We are updating the entry point user interface for Copilot Chat. The Copilot Chat entry point button will move out of the app ribbon to the app canvas to help with discoverability and use within the context of the file. This update will apply to Microsoft 365 users of Word, Excel and PowerPoint who are eligible for Copilot Chat across web, mobile and desktop.
